{{Quote|Now, if we were to re-route the primary power couplings of this beauty onto the &lt;transmission garbled&gt; and through the inverse feedback proton chain &lt;transmission garbled&gt; then tune the hydro-facilitator to provide tertiary cooling to &lt;transmission garbled&gt; encasing the magnetron-accelerator in a warped plasma core and &lt;transmission garbled&gt; we should see some serious &lt;transmission censored&gt;.|Yan Dom Guez's final recording|<ref name="Cannon">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "Fusion Accelerator Cannon - Prototype" databank entry}}</ref>}}
[[Technician/Legends|Chief Weapon Tech]] '''Yan Dom Guez''' worked on the prototype [[Fusion Accelerator Cannon]] sometime before or during<ref name="Cannon" /> [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' project in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the databank have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref> The final recording from Yan Dom Guez about the Cannon was salvaged from [[B'Ya Weapons Testing Facility]].<ref name="Cannon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yan Dom Guez was first mentioned in the "Fusion Accelerator Cannon - Prototype" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="Cannon" />
